build.extensionBinarySHA256Availability: Not recorded in the frozen comparison manifest; extension build and source hashes are recorded.
build.sourceHashValidationScope: Compares repository files with the frozen manifest; does not revalidate a running executable.

design.sourceSampling: Samples the latest WMC texture at each admitted 30 Hz tick; upstream unique-image cadence was not independently measured.

provenance.chrome: Version from each primary window census-before.json executable paths; those paths are omitted from this public summary.
provenance.machineTiming: Read-only environment confirmation after the measurements. Logical CPU count also remained 16 in all primary CPU samples.

findings.interpretation: 720p reduced observed producer GPU command time and Host physical footprint in both oriented pairs. CPU reductions were not observed; the small CPU increase does not establish that resolution caused a regression.

fixedWorkloadValidation.requirements: Output and GPU transformation FPS 29.5..30.5; no repeated outputs; complete GPU timing; same upstream dimensions/source kind/transport mode; raw CPU counters and process identities valid

limitations: Two windows per condition (N=2); descriptive observations, not a statistical significance test or causal isolation of resolution.
Meet A+B contains sender and receiver on the same Mac. Sender/receiver role is not inferred from the process labels.
Selected Chrome main/GPU/network/storage/audio/capture services also serve unrelated user work. This is not whole-Chrome or Meet-only CPU.
Whole-Mac CPU includes background work and uses a different 0..100 scale from one-core process CPU.
GPU transformations and submitted frames are approximately 30 per second in every window, with no cached output repeats. The earlier varying-transformation-cadence confound does not apply.
Thirty GPU transformations per second does not prove 30 independent upstream images per second; WMC uses mutable image storage and new-frame notifications can coalesce.
Producer status-window boundaries differ from CPU sample boundaries by approximately one status interval. A4 producer deltas cover about 41 seconds while its CPU window covers about 40 seconds.
GPU command time is neither whole-system GPU utilization nor Chrome encode time or end-to-end latency.
Host physical footprint does not establish whole-Mac memory savings; RSS and shared-memory mappings are not summed.
Power consumption, whole-system GPU utilization, and whole-Mac memory reductions were not measured.

Actual RTP resolution, encoded FPS, and bitrate for these four primary CPU windows are unverified because retained RTP history did not cover them. Separate supplementary measurements do not retroactively prove those windows.

measurementDefinitions.conditionSummaries: Unweighted means and minimum/maximum across two windows per condition.
measurementDefinitions.gpuTime: Producer GPU command execution time, not system GPU utilization, Chrome encoding time, or end-to-end latency.
measurementDefinitions.hostPhysicalFootprint: proc_pid_rusage physicalFootprintBytes. Each window uses the median of its samples; condition values are the unweighted mean of the two window medians. MiB = 1048576 bytes. RSS/shared-memory mappings are not summed.
measurementDefinitions.orientedPairs: A1 minus B2 and A4 minus B3. A positive reduction means the 720p observation is lower.
measurementDefinitions.processCPU: Cumulative user+system CPU-time delta divided by each process wall interval. 100 percent means one logical CPU fully occupied. Selected process sums are not whole-Chrome or sender-only CPU.
measurementDefinitions.producerCounterBoundaries: Host-written status snapshots are distinct from CPU sample boundaries and may differ by approximately one status interval (~1 second).
measurementDefinitions.transportPixelCopiesCounter: This source-mode counter counts the one GPU transform/write per output, not a CPU copy or a second transform.
measurementDefinitions.wholeMacCPU: host_statistics(HOST_CPU_LOAD_INFO) unsigned 32-bit modular tick deltas: 100*(user+system+nice)/(user+system+nice+idle). 100 percent means all logical CPUs occupied.
measurementDefinitions.wholeMacOneCoreEquivalent: Whole-Mac percent on the 0..100 scale multiplied by the stable logical CPU count (16).
